content.json:
# DevGlobe Product Adoption
Product-owner view of reach, usage, acquisition, conversion, retention, and MCP adoption. Scorecard metrics compare the latest seven days with the preceding seven days, exclude synthetic and localhost traffic, and suppress cohorts below three browsers.

## Weekly adoption and retention scorecard
Funnel: production visitor → explicit search submission → profile open → primary action. Instrumentation version 2 begins durable visitor/search coverage; earlier periods are incomplete. Initial targets should be recalibrated after four complete production weeks.

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | where url !startswith 'http://localhost' and url !startswith 'https://localhost' | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Route=tostring(parse_url(url).Path), Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url); let ProductionSessions=P | distinct session_Id; let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | join kind=inner ProductionSessions on session_Id | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Journey=tostring(customDimensions.journey); let Cohorts=(Start:datetime,End:datetime) { let Visits=P | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End | summarize Visit=min(timestamp) by Browser; let Searches=Visits | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='search_submitted' | project Browser,SearchEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=minif(SearchEvent,SearchEvent>=Visit) by Browser; let Profiles=Searches | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='profile_viewed' | project Browser,ProfileEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=take_any(Search),Profile=minif(ProfileEvent,ProfileEvent>=Search) by Browser; Profiles | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='next_action_selected' and Journey=='profile_primary_action' | project Browser,ActionEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=take_any(Search),Profile=take_any(Profile),Action=minif(ActionEvent,ActionEvent>=Profile) by Browser }; let Boundary=ago(7d); let C=Cohorts(Boundary,now()); let R=Cohorts(Boundary-7d,Boundary); let CV=todouble(toscalar(C | count)); let PV=todouble(toscalar(R | count)); let CS=todouble(toscalar(C | summarize countif(isnotnull(Search)))); let PS=todouble(toscalar(R | summarize countif(isnotnull(Search)))); let CP=todouble(toscalar(C | summarize countif(isnotnull(Profile)))); let PP=todouble(toscalar(R | summarize countif(isnotnull(Profile)))); let CA=todouble(toscalar(C | summarize countif(isnotnull(Action)))); let PA=todouble(toscalar(R | summarize countif(isnotnull(Action)))); union (print Metric='Visitors',Current7d=CV,Previous7d=PV,Target=100.0), (print Metric='Search submissions',Current7d=CS,Previous7d=PS,Target=30.0), (print Metric='Profile opens',Current7d=CP,Previous7d=PP,Target=20.0), (print Metric='Primary actions',Current7d=CA,Previous7d=PA,Target=10.0), (print Metric='Visitor to search %',Current7d=iff(CV<3,real(null),round(100.0*CS/CV,1)),Previous7d=iff(PV<3,real(null),round(100.0*PS/PV,1)),Target=25.0), (print Metric='Search to profile %',Current7d=iff(CS<3,real(null),round(100.0*CP/CS,1)),Previous7d=iff(PS<3,real(null),round(100.0*PP/PS,1)),Target=50.0), (print Metric='Profile to action %',Current7d=iff(CP<3,real(null),round(100.0*CA/CP,1)),Previous7d=iff(PP<3,real(null),round(100.0*PA/PP,1)),Target=15.0) | extend Current7d=iff(Current7d<3 and Metric !endswith '%',real(null),Current7d),Previous7d=iff(Previous7d<3 and Metric !endswith '%',real(null),Previous7d),Change=round(Current7d-Previous7d,1),Status=case(isnull(Current7d),'Privacy suppressed',Current7d>=Target,'On target','Below target')
content.title: Current vs previous 7 days

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | where url !startswith 'http://localhost' and url !startswith 'https://localhost' | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Route=tostring(parse_url(url).Path), Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url); let ProductionSessions=P | distinct session_Id; let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | join kind=inner ProductionSessions on session_Id | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Journey=tostring(customDimensions.journey); let Cohorts=(Start:datetime,End:datetime) { let Visits=P | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End | summarize Visit=min(timestamp) by Browser; let Searches=Visits | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='search_submitted' | project Browser,SearchEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=minif(SearchEvent,SearchEvent>=Visit) by Browser; let Profiles=Searches | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='profile_viewed' | project Browser,ProfileEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=take_any(Search),Profile=minif(ProfileEvent,ProfileEvent>=Search) by Browser; Profiles | join kind=leftouter (E | where timestamp>=Start and timestamp<End and name=='next_action_selected' and Journey=='profile_primary_action' | project Browser,ActionEvent=timestamp) on Browser | summarize Visit=take_any(Visit),Search=take_any(Search),Profile=take_any(Profile),Action=minif(ActionEvent,ActionEvent>=Profile) by Browser }; let S=Cohorts(ago(7d),now()); union (S | summarize Browsers=count() | extend Order=1,Stage='Visitors'), (S | summarize Browsers=countif(isnotnull(Search)) | extend Order=2,Stage='Search submitted'), (S | summarize Browsers=countif(isnotnull(Profile)) | extend Order=3,Stage='Profile opened'), (S | summarize Browsers=countif(isnotnull(Action)) | extend Order=4,Stage='Primary action') | extend Browsers=iff(Browsers<3,long(null),Browsers) | order by Order asc | project Stage,Browsers
content.title: Visitor to primary action - last 7 days

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | where url !startswith 'http://localhost' and url !startswith 'https://localhost' | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Route=tostring(parse_url(url).Path), Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url); let ProductionSessions=P | distinct session_Id; let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | join kind=inner ProductionSessions on session_Id | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Journey=tostring(customDimensions.journey); let V=P | summarize FirstSeen=min(timestamp),LastSeen=max(timestamp) by Browser; union (V | summarize Eligible=countif(FirstSeen<ago(7d)),Returned=countif(FirstSeen<ago(7d) and LastSeen>=ago(7d)) | extend Window='7-day',Target=20.0), (V | summarize Eligible=countif(FirstSeen<ago(30d)),Returned=countif(FirstSeen<ago(30d) and LastSeen>=ago(30d)) | extend Window='30-day',Target=10.0) | extend ReturnRate=iff(Eligible<3 or Returned<3,real(null),round(100.0*Returned/Eligible,1)) | project Window,Eligible=iff(Eligible<3,long(null),Eligible),Returned=iff(Returned<3,long(null),Returned),ReturnRate,Target,Status=case(isnull(ReturnRate),'Privacy suppressed',ReturnRate>=Target,'On target','Below target')
content.title: 7/30-day browser retention

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | where url !startswith 'http://localhost' and url !startswith 'https://localhost' | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Route=tostring(parse_url(url).Path), Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url); let ProductionSessions=P | distinct session_Id; let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | join kind=inner ProductionSessions on session_Id | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Journey=tostring(customDimensions.journey); P | where timestamp >= ago(30d) | extend AcquisitionSource=iff(isempty(Source),'Direct / unattributed',Source) | summarize Visitors=dcount(Browser),Views=count() by Route,AcquisitionSource | where Visitors>=3 | top 25 by Visitors desc
content.title: Production routes and acquisition sources

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | where url !startswith 'http://localhost' and url !startswith 'https://localhost' | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Route=tostring(parse_url(url).Path), Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url); let ProductionSessions=P | distinct session_Id; let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(180d) and isempty(operation_SyntheticSource) | join kind=inner ProductionSessions on session_Id | extend Browser=iff(isempty(user_Id), session_Id, user_Id), Journey=tostring(customDimensions.journey); let Required=datatable(EventName:string)['site_visited','search_submitted','profile_viewed','next_action_selected']; let FunnelEvents=union (P | project timestamp,name='site_visited'), (E | where name!='next_action_selected' or Journey=='profile_primary_action' | project timestamp,name); Required | join kind=leftouter (FunnelEvents | where timestamp>=ago(7d) | summarize Events=count(),LastSeen=max(timestamp) by EventName=name) on EventName | extend Events=toint(coalesce(Events,0)) | extend Status=case(isnull(LastSeen) or Events==0,'ALERT: missing',LastSeen<ago(24h),'ALERT: stale','Healthy') | project EventName,Events,LastSeen,Status
content.title: Required funnel telemetry health

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(30d); let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(30d); union (P | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Page views'), (P | summarize Value=dcount(user_Id) | extend Metric='Active users'), (P | summarize Value=dcount(session_Id) | extend Metric='Sessions'), (E | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Product actions') | project Metric, Value
content.title: 30-day product health

content.query: pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(30d) | summarize PageViews=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by Day=startofday(timestamp) | order by Day asc
content.title: Daily traffic and active users

content.query: pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(30d) | extend Page=iff(isempty(name), tostring(parse_url(url).Path), name) | summarize Views=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by Page | top 15 by Views desc
content.title: Top pages

content.json:
## Feature adoption
Which intentional product actions users take after arriving.

content.query: customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(30d) | summarize Actions=count(), Users=dcount(user_Id), Sessions=dcount(session_Id) by Feature=name | top 15 by Sessions desc
content.title: Feature adoption by session

content.query: pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(30d) | extend Source=extract(@'[?&]utm_source=([^&]+)', 1, url), Campaign=extract(@'[?&]utm_campaign=([^&]+)', 1, url) | extend Source=iff(isempty(Source), 'Direct / unattributed', Source), Campaign=iff(isempty(Campaign), 'None', Campaign) | summarize Sessions=dcount(session_Id), Users=dcount(user_Id), Views=count() by Source, Campaign | top 15 by Sessions desc
content.title: Acquisition sources

content.json:
## Conversion funnels
Stages are ordered within the same Application Insights session. Counts are directional product signals, not identity-level attribution.

content.query: let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(30d) and isnotempty(session_Id); let S=E | summarize Profile=minif(timestamp, name == 'profile_viewed'), Card=minif(timestamp, name == 'card_generated'), Share=minif(timestamp, name in ('identity_card_shared','agent_profile_shared')), Claim=minif(timestamp, name == 'claim_completed') by session_Id; union (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Profile)) | extend StepOrder=1, Stage='Profile viewed'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Profile) and Card >= Profile) | extend StepOrder=2, Stage='Card generated'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Profile) and Card >= Profile and Share >= Card) | extend StepOrder=3, Stage='Profile shared'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Profile) and Claim >= Profile) | extend StepOrder=4, Stage='Profile claimed') | order by StepOrder asc | project Stage, Sessions
content.title: Profile value funnel

content.query: let E=customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(30d) and isnotempty(session_Id); let S=E | summarize Preview=minif(timestamp, name in ('mission_preview_requested','mission_preview_shown')), Viewed=minif(timestamp, name == 'mission_viewed'), Accepted=minif(timestamp, name == 'mission_accepted'), Completed=minif(timestamp, name == 'mission_completed') by session_Id; union (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Preview)) | extend StepOrder=1, Stage='Preview'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Preview) and Viewed >= Preview) | extend StepOrder=2, Stage='Viewed'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Viewed) and Accepted >= Viewed) | extend StepOrder=3, Stage='Accepted'), (S | summarize Sessions=countif(isnotnull(Accepted) and Completed >= Accepted) | extend StepOrder=4, Stage='Completed') | order by StepOrder asc | project Stage, Sessions
content.title: Daily mission funnel

content.query: let P=pageViews | where timestamp >= ago(30d) and isnotempty(session_Id); let SessionDepth=P | summarize PageViews=count(), DistinctPages=dcount(name) by session_Id; SessionDepth | extend Depth=case(PageViews == 1, '1 view', PageViews between (2 .. 3), '2-3 views', PageViews between (4 .. 7), '4-7 views', '8+ views') | summarize Sessions=count() by Depth
content.title: Session depth

content.json:
## Weekly impact return loop
Only verified, explicitly opted-in contacts are eligible. A first run records the comparison baseline without sending email; messages require rank movement, a fresh contribution opportunity, or a pending introduction request. The return-rate target is at least 20% over seven days.

content.query: let D=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d) and Log_s has '"event":"devglobe_weekly_digest"' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_weekly_digest' and tostring(Metric.outcome) == 'completed'; let Totals=D | summarize Eligible=sum(toint(Metric.eligible)), Baselines=sum(toint(Metric.reasons.baselineCreated)), Suppressed=sum(toint(Metric.reasons.noMeaningfulUpdate)), ProviderAccepted=sum(toint(Metric.providerAccepted)), ProviderFailed=sum(toint(Metric.providerFailed)); let Returns=toscalar(customEvents | where timestamp >= ago(7d) and name == 'weekly_digest_returned' | summarize dcount(session_Id)); Totals | extend ReturnSessions=Returns, ReturnRate=iff(ProviderAccepted == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Returns / ProviderAccepted, 1)), Target=20.0 | extend TargetGap=round(ReturnRate - Target, 1) | project Metric=pack_array('Eligible contacts', 'Baselines created', 'No meaningful update', 'Provider accepted', 'Provider failed', 'Return sessions', 'Return rate %', 'Target gap (pp)'), Value=pack_array(todouble(Eligible), todouble(Baselines), todouble(Suppressed), todouble(ProviderAccepted), todouble(ProviderFailed), todouble(ReturnSessions), ReturnRate, TargetGap) | mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)
content.title: Weekly impact email - last 7 days

content.json:
## MCP adoption and reliability
Privacy-safe usage of the public DevGlobe MCP endpoint. Client values are bounded families; prompts, tool arguments, tokens, and raw user agents are never collected.

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); let T=M | summarize Calls=count(), ToolCalls=countif(Method == 'tools/call'), PromptLists=countif(Method == 'prompts/list'), PromptGets=countif(Method == 'prompts/get'), ProjectReads=countif(Method == 'resources/read' and Resource == 'devglobe://project'), CallerDays=dcountif(CallerHash, isnotempty(CallerHash)), Successful=countif(Outcome == 'success'), P95LatencyMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95); T | extend SuccessRate=iff(Calls == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Successful / Calls, 1)) | project Metric=pack_array('Requests', 'Tool calls', 'Prompt lists', 'Prompt opens', 'Project resource reads', 'Correlated caller-days', 'Success rate %', 'P95 latency ms'), Value=pack_array(todouble(Calls), todouble(ToolCalls), todouble(PromptLists), todouble(PromptGets), todouble(ProjectReads), todouble(CallerDays), SuccessRate, P95LatencyMs) | mv-expand Metric to typeof(string), Value to typeof(real)
content.title: MCP health - last 30 days

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); M | summarize Requests=count(), PromptLists=countif(Method == 'prompts/list'), PromptOpens=countif(Method == 'prompts/get'), ProjectReads=countif(Method == 'resources/read' and Resource == 'devglobe://project'), Errors=countif(Outcome == 'error') by Day=startofday(Timestamp) | order by Day asc
content.title: Daily MCP requests, prompt use, project reads, and errors

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); M | where Method == 'tools/call' and Tool != 'none' | summarize Calls=count(), Successful=countif(Outcome == 'success'), Results=sum(ResultCount), P95LatencyMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) by Tool | extend SuccessRate=round(100.0 * Successful / Calls, 1) | project Tool, Calls, SuccessRate, P95LatencyMs, Results | order by Calls desc
content.title: Tool adoption

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); M | summarize Requests=count(), ToolCalls=countif(Method == 'tools/call'), PromptOpens=countif(Method == 'prompts/get'), ProjectReads=countif(Method == 'resources/read' and Resource == 'devglobe://project') by Client | order by Requests desc
content.title: MCP client mix

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); M | extend Operation=case(Prompt != 'none', Prompt, Tool != 'none', Tool, Resource != 'none', Resource, 'none') | summarize Requests=count(), Errors=countif(Outcome == 'error'), P50LatencyMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 0), P95LatencyMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 0) by Method, Operation | extend SuccessRate=round(100.0 * (Requests - Errors) / Requests, 1) | project Method, Operation, Requests, SuccessRate, P50LatencyMs, P95LatencyMs | order by Requests desc
content.title: Reliability by method and operation

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); let C=M | where isnotempty(CallerHash) | summarize Initialized=countif(Method == 'initialize') > 0, Listed=countif(Method == 'tools/list') > 0, ListedPrompts=countif(Method == 'prompts/list') > 0, OpenedPrompt=countif(Method == 'prompts/get') > 0, Called=countif(Method == 'tools/call') > 0, Succeeded=countif(Method == 'tools/call' and Outcome == 'success') > 0 by CallerHash; union (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized) | extend StepOrder=1, Stage='Initialized'), (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized and Listed) | extend StepOrder=2, Stage='Listed tools'), (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized and ListedPrompts) | extend StepOrder=3, Stage='Listed prompts'), (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized and OpenedPrompt) | extend StepOrder=4, Stage='Opened a prompt'), (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized and Listed and Called) | extend StepOrder=5, Stage='Called a tool'), (C | summarize CallerDays=countif(Initialized and Listed and Called and Succeeded) | extend StepOrder=6, Stage='Successful tool result') | order by StepOrder asc | project Stage, CallerDays
content.title: MCP caller-day conversion

content.query: let M=workspace('c97b958c-a52f-45b5-bcc1-d7eb355850ff').ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) and Log_s has 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Metric=parse_json(Log_s) | where tostring(Metric.event) == 'devglobe_mcp' | extend Timestamp=TimeGenerated, Method=tostring(Metric.method), Tool=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.tool)), 'none', tostring(Metric.tool)), Resource=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.resource)), 'none', tostring(Metric.resource)), Prompt=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.prompt)), 'none', tostring(Metric.prompt)), Client=iff(isempty(tostring(Metric.client)), 'unknown', tostring(Metric.client)), Outcome=tostring(Metric.outcome), DurationMs=todouble(Metric.durationMs), ResultCount=todouble(Metric.resultCount), CallerHash=tostring(Metric.callerHash), ErrorCode=tostring(Metric.errorCode); M | where Outcome == 'error' | extend ErrorCode=iff(isempty(ErrorCode), 'unclassified', ErrorCode) | summarize Errors=count(), CallerDays=dcountif(CallerHash, isnotempty(CallerHash)), LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by ErrorCode, Tool | order by Errors desc
content.title: MCP errors by code
